description: Resume or save the Stranote session (shared with Claude Code and Codex). No text = RESUME; `update "<what changed>"` = rewrite STATE.md.

Read `.agents/skills/stranote-resume/SKILL.md` and follow it exactly. Text typed after this command is its argument
(empty = RESUME, `update "..."` = UPDATE). Rules: `AGENTS.md`. State: `STATE.md`.
